narrative: On the board. The loose leaf from Wednesday, at the upstairs table. The two lines, and under them the call. Nothing is struck. The red bundle is apart and tied. On the board. The pen lies beside the leaf. The word is untouched. No lower line is written under it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the call and left it standing.

entities.name: the vial speech
entities.context: Shown on draft in The call, unstruck
